label: Trendyol
terms_note: Trendyol Partner Program seller (Turkish tax entity for TR; separate international programme); credentials generated by the master user; third-party integrators identify with `SupplierId - IntegratorName` (≤ 30 alphanumerics); rate limits per service group and per endpoint (50 / 10 s), barcode-level price updates 30 / min, identical price-stock requests blocked for 15 min; stage environment with separate credentials + test orders.

discovery.auth: basic (Supplier ID + API key + API secret from Seller Center › Integration Information, master/admin login; `Authorization: Basic base64(apiKey:apiSecret)`; mandatory `User-Agent: <SupplierId> - <IntegratorName|SelfIntegration>`)
sdks: llms.txt + .md mirrors of every page (developers.trendyol.com/llms.txt) for agents

rate_limits: 50 requests / 10 s per endpoint (429 "Too Many Requests"); from 2026-09-14 grouped per-minute limits by listing tier: Product Read 1,000–2,000/min, Product Write 200–600/min, Inventory & Price Write 350–2,000/min, price update 30/min per barcode; Buybox 1,000/min; V1 product services off 2026-09-15,

auth: 1. Seller Center (master/admin) › Account › Integration Information → Supplier ID, API key, API secret (PROD and STAGE differ).
2. Basic auth on every call + the mandatory User-Agent (403 without it).
3. Register webhooks for order / package events.

items[{barcode, quantity, salePrice, listPrice}] ≤ 1,000; ≤ 20,000 stock; 15-min dedupe; batchRequestId
status / date filters; stream endpoint for polling

reference.limits: Per service group (2026-09-14 table): product read 1,000–2,000 / min, product write 200–600 / min, inventory-price write 350–2,000 / min (catalogue-size tiers), barcode-level price 30 / min, order fetch 30–100 / min, returns fetch 1,000 / approve 5 per min, Q&A 1,000 / reply 500, finance 100, barcode 100; plus 50 requests per endpoint per 10 s → 429. - Partner Program contract; integrator identification via User-Agent is mandatory. - V1 services shut down 2026-09-15 (product) and 2026-10-15 (order).

config_fields.name: seller_id
config_fields.help: Your Trendyol seller (supplier) ID from the same Integration Information page; used in every path.

config_fields.help: Mandatory User-Agent (requests without it get 403): '<sellerId> - SelfIntegration' for your own software, or '<sellerId> - <IntegratorName>' (alphanumeric, max 30 characters) when an integrator company runs it, e.g. '1234 - SelfIntegration'.

config_fields.help: apigw.trendyol.com (PROD) or stageapigw.trendyol.com (STAGE, IP-authorised test environment).

adapter.terms: Trendyol Partner API: at most 50 requests per 10 seconds to the same endpoint (429 too.many.requests beyond); getShipmentPackages at most 1000 requests/minute. Price/stock and archive calls are asynchronous batches (check getBatchRequestResult with the returned batchRequestId).

me.note: getSuppliersAddresses returns your shipment/return/invoice addresses ({supplierAddresses[], defaultShipmentAddress...}) — used as the credential check.

update_listing.note: updatePriceAndInventory {items: [{barcode, salePrice, listPrice, quantity}]} changes the LIVE sale price and/or sellable stock of an approved product; `listing_id` is the product barcode. listPrice (the crossed-out original price) is sent equal to salePrice, so no discount is displayed. Asynchronous: raw.batchRequestId → getBatchRequestResult. Re-sending an identical body within 15 minutes is rejected. Titles/descriptions go through product update services, not here.

set_inventory.note: updatePriceAndInventory {items: [{barcode, quantity}]} sets the sellable stock (max 20,000). `sku` must be the product BARCODE Trendyol knows it by. Asynchronous batch (raw.batchRequestId).

end_listing.note: archiveProducts {items: [{barcode, archived: true}]} archives the product: it becomes invisible on Trendyol but is not deleted (reversible with archived: false). `listing_id` is the barcode. Asynchronous batch.

list_orders.note: getShipmentPackages (v2, mandatory from 15 Oct 2026): one row per SHIPMENT PACKAGE (raw.id is the package id; a split order has several packages with the same orderNumber). status: Created|Picking|Invoiced|Shipped|Cancelled|Delivered|UnDelivered|Returned|AtCollectionPoint|UnPacked|UnSupplied|Awaiting|Verified. Without a date window the endpoint returns the last week; `since` is not sent because startDate must be epoch milliseconds (GMT+3). orderDate is epoch ms; total is packageTotalPrice (net of discounts).

not_offered.create_listing: Product creation (createProducts v2) needs categoryId, brandId, category attributes, cargo company and shipment/return address ids, VAT rate and images per barcode, and goes through Trendyol approval; the vocabulary has no category, brand or attribute inputs.
not_offered.mark_shipped: Shipping uses the Trendyol-contracted cargo provider assigned to the package (cargoTrackingNumber is created by Trendyol); the seller only reports package statuses with updatePackage (Picking, then Invoiced with lines[{lineId, quantity}] and an invoice number) — there is no seller call that submits a carrier and tracking number for an order.
